purpose: Smoke test of dspy.Predict(RouteTool) against the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint before spending on a full pilot.

predicted_arguments.goal: Generate Hindi narration of the provided script using the voice from sample_data/demo2_hindi_spoken_monologue.ogg.
assumptions: The user is authorized to use the supplied voice sample for voice cloning.
The requested narration is for a non-deceptive use.
steps: Use the supplied Hindi audio sample as the voice reference.
Synthesize the exact Hindi script in the referenced voice.

cases.note: The router correctly chose submit_plan but marked voice cloning feasible. No tool exposes a reference-audio or speaker-embedding parameter, so the gold label is feasible=false. This is exactly the failure mode the 0.2 argument component of the metric is meant to catch.
The router chose the zero-cost pre-flight metadata call instead of paid OCR, matching the gold decision point.

conclusion: The DSPy router works against gpt-6-luna. Tool routing is already strong on these two cases; argument/feasibility grounding is the next target for GEPA. Run the notebook with RUN_BASELINES=True for the 12-case pilot.
